connector.name: Alpacacloud MCP
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI agents to Alpaca Cloud: Postgres, Auth, Storage, Sandboxes, and Workflows.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.alpaca-cloud.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the melgencer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ALPACACLOUD_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token (alp_pat_…) — unlocks account-wide Sandboxes + Workflows tools

env.name: ALPACACLOUD_SANDBOX_TEMPLATE
env.description: Default sandbox image: python | node | base (default python)

env.name: ALPACACLOUD_SANDBOX_NETWORK
env.description: true to allow outbound network in sandboxes (default false)
